nodes.text:
But this isn’t all bad news.

Uncertainty often creates opportunities for sharp investors.

Short-term market pullbacks could give long-term investors a chance to accumulate.

HMPV isn’t causing panic yet, but markets often overreact before the facts are clear.

nodes.author: EvanLuthra
nodes.text:
The good news is that crypto today is far more resilient than it was in early 2020:

⟜ Institutional adoption is strong, with BTC seen as “digital gold.”

⟜ DeFi is maturing, offering alternative income streams during volatile periods.

⟜ On-chain data shows strong HODLing behavior among long-term holders.

⟜ Even if short-term volatility strikes, the long-term fundamentals are solid.
